### Family Religion
Author: Melton Duncan
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/family-religion
Passage: Isaiah 59:21
Points:
- Scripture consistently demonstrates that God connects people to Himself through covenant promises given across generations.
- In Isaiah 59:21, the Lord pledges that His Spirit and His words will never depart from His people, their children, or their descendants.
- Families serve as a primary and vital avenue for evangelism and passing on faith in both testaments.
- Believers are called to thank God for Christian households and church communities that faithfully transmit His redemptive truth.

### Judgment and Salvation
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/judgment-and-salvation
Passage: Isaiah 59:14-21
Points:
- The Holy Spirit works through the warnings and promises of Scripture to keep the elect persevering in faith.
- When society suppresses truth and preys on those who follow God, believers are tempted to compromise and blend in.
- The Lord will not hold back His wrath forever; He will personally suit up to repay His adversaries according to their deeds.
- Believers can endure hardship because God promises the Redeemer will come to Zion to vindicate all who turn from transgression.
